summary_1line: Bhrigu explains the austere life of wandering renunciates and describes a pure northern realm beyond the Himalayas where righteous souls dwell.

image_candidates.scene_text: A lone Parivrajaka ascetic with a wooden bowl walks through mountains and riverbanks, clothed in rags and gazing equally at gold and stones.
Beyond the snowy Himalayas lies a radiant land where serene people dwell in golden palaces while others meditate austerely without sickness or strife.
A silent wandering sage pours alms into his own mouth as a symbolic offering to the inner fire of his body.
